description: Hand-maintained annotations for the generated configuration/state file reference. The generator verifies each file-name literal appears in its declared_in source, so entries cannot rot silently.

files.name: provider.json
files.description_en: Non-secret Provider configuration: provider id, HTTPS base URL, opaque SecretRef, optional snapshot digest.
files.description_zh: 非 secret 的 Provider 配置：provider id、HTTPS base URL、不透明 SecretRef、可选 snapshot digest。

files.name: selected-model.json
files.description_en: Selected chat-capable model plus the discovery snapshot digest it was chosen from.
files.description_zh: 选定的可对话模型及其来源发现快照的 digest。

files.name: pi.json
files.description_en: Non-secret Pi launch configuration: absolute executable and Extension entry paths.
files.description_zh: 非 secret 的 Pi 启动配置：可执行文件与 Extension 入口的绝对路径。

files.name: daemon-endpoint.json
files.description_en: Atomically published loopback endpoint document consumed by CLI and Pi extension.
files.description_zh: 原子发布的 loopback endpoint 文档，供 CLI 与 Pi 扩展消费。

files.name: local-bootstrap.secret
files.description_en: Per-boot bootstrap proof (0600) exchanged at POST /local/session for channel-bound bearers. Never leaves the local machine.
files.description_zh: 每次启动的 bootstrap 证明（0600），在 POST /local/session 兑换通道绑定 bearer。绝不离开本机。

files.name: migration.lock
files.description_en: Exclusive lock taken while preparing/migrating the two SQLite databases.
files.description_zh: 准备/迁移两个 SQLite 数据库期间持有的排他锁。

files.name: daemon.lock
files.description_en: Single-daemon-instance lock; `cognitive daemon stop` removes it only after confirming staleness.
files.description_zh: daemon 单实例锁；`cognitive daemon stop` 仅在确认过期后移除。

files.name: active-version
files.description_en: Atomic text pointer naming the active installed bundle version; switched only after health confirmation.
files.description_zh: 指向当前激活 bundle 版本的原子文本指针；仅在健康确认后切换。
